items.title: Dalton Kincaid: Two catches in return
items.text:

items.title: Patrick Mahomes: Unremarkable numbers in loss
items.text:
Mahomes completed 16 of 29 passes for 174 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions and rushed three times for two yards in the Chiefs' 13-10 loss to the Bills on Thursday. He also fumbled twice but recovered on each occasion.

items.title: Emmett Johnson: Another TD in Week 12 loss
items.text:
